title: 2021 Topps Update Series #US97 Adam Duvall Miami Marlins Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2021 Topps Update Series Adam Duvall baseball card featuring the player from the Miami Marlins. This original sports trading card is part of the Major League (MLB) set and is not autographed. Manufactured by Topps in the United States, the card is in English and has a card number of US97, representing the 2021 season. Perfect for collectors and fans of the sport, this card captures a moment in baseball history with the player in his Miami Marlins uniform.
